provisionalHint: Converted with a reference rate; it updates once the charged amount is entered.
restricted: You see only the lines of your teams and batches. Other lines and the order's accounting are summarised.

incomplete.title: Amounts cannot be computed yet:
incomplete.no_conversion: Enter the amount actually charged, or set a reference rate for {{currency}}.
incomplete.original_total_zero: The original total is 0, so the charged amount cannot be spread.
incomplete.entry_no_conversion: Enter the actual base-currency amount of cost entry #{{entry}} ({{currency}}), or set a reference rate for {{currency}}.
incomplete.allocation_invalid: The split of cost entry #{{entry}} does not match any line of this order.

breakdown.title: How the amounts are calculated
breakdown.restricted: Accounting for lines of other teams is not shown.
breakdown.invariantOk: Check passed: net total equals the sum of the line totals
breakdown.invariantBroken: Check failed: net total differs from the sum of the line totals
breakdown.invariantUnknown: Check unavailable until the amounts can be computed

line.title: Lines
line.name: Name
line.quantityInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
line.removeHelp: Remove "{{name}}" from this draft order? The item goes back to the purchasing queue.

close.title: Close the missing quantity
close.short_accepted: Accept the shortage (the vendor sent less)
close.reopenHelp: The line is open again and its refund entry is voided.

details.title: Order details
details.chargedHelp: What the card or bank actually charged. Add it later when known; until then amounts use the reference rate.

actions.cancelHelp: Cancel this draft order? Its items return to the purchasing queue.
actions.unplaceHelp: The order goes back to draft. Deliveries, problems, closures, refunds and extra charges must be undone first.
actions.uncancelHelp: The order goes back to draft if its items can still be ordered.

list.title: Vendor orders
list.intro: Orders placed with vendors. You see the orders that include your team's lines.
list.search: Search by VO number or vendor order number

queue.title: Purchasing
queue.intro: Approved items still to buy, across teams and grouped by vendor. Pick items to create or extend a draft order.
queue.skipRemaining: Do not buy the remaining quantity
queue.emptyHint: Items appear here once a batch's review is confirmed.
queue.unpurchasableHelp: "{{name}}": the remaining quantity will not be bought. You can undo this later.

send.title: Add to a vendor order
send.mergeHint_one: {{count}} team has items for this vendor.
send.mergeHint_other: {{count}} teams have items for this vendor. Consider one order for all of them.

refundInput.amountHelp: Optional, entered as a positive amount; it becomes a refund cost entry on this line.
refundInput.actualHelp: Optional. What the refund really came to in the base currency; you can fill it in later.

costs.title: Costs and adjustments
costs.deleteHelp: Delete this entry? Its amounts are removed from the order.
costs.voidHelp: The entry stays on record, struck through, and its amounts leave the order.
costs.derivedHint: Created by a closure or problem resolution. To remove it, undo that closure or resolution.
costs.actualHelp: What it really came to in the base currency. Leave empty to use the reference rate (provisional); fill it in later to finalize.

settlementHelp.with_checkout: Paid in the same checkout as the goods; always in the order currency.
settlementHelp.separate: Paid or refunded on its own, in any supported currency.

costs.forcedSeparate: Refunds and extra charges are always separate.
costs.placedOnlyHint: Refunds and extra charges can be added once the order is placed.
costs.currencyLocked: Costs paid with the goods use the order currency ({{currency}}).

signHint.negative: Enter a negative amount (it lowers the cost).
signHint.any: Positive for a cost, negative for a reduction.

costs.couponUsedHint: Enter the coupon's face value: the team using the coupon pays full price, and the coupon's issuing refund was booked at face value.
costs.couponRefundHint: A coupon refund is booked at face value. When the coupon is used later, add a Coupon used entry (positive, face value) on the order where it is used.
costs.noteCouponHelp: For a coupon without a fixed value (such as 10% off), do not book it; mention it here.

modeHelp.all: Spread over every line by its price.
modeHelp.teams: Spread over the lines of the chosen teams by price.
modeHelp.lines: Spread over the chosen lines by price.
modeHelp.manual: Enter the amount for each line; they must add up to the amount.

costs.byRequester: Pick items requested by a person
costs.byRequesterHelp: Adds every line whose item this person requested.
costs.editAudit: Changes are recorded in the timeline and the amounts are recalculated.
costs.allocationsReset: Some teams or lines that a cost entry was split to are gone, so those entries now split over all lines. Check the costs and adjustments table.

errors.placedOnly: Refunds and extra charges need a placed order.
errors.manualEmpty: Enter an amount for at least one line.
errors.manualSum: The line amounts must add up to the amount.
